forum.title: CCID USBD transfer block on F1
forum.author: Ayoub-Marghoub

scraped_replies.html:
HI  @Ayoub-Marghoub 

Your custom modification in USBD_CCID_DataIn is not recommended.

In my understanding, CCID is length driven, not chunk driven. I mean, the host does not wait for a fifth chunk just because you intended one. It should wait for:

  • the number of bytes declared in the CCID header
  • or a short packet that terminates the transfer
